# 062 — Companion Art Is a Generated, Curated Library

**Status:** Decided (2026-08-07, M4/9 direction session)

## Decision

**Companion art is generated by an image model at build time, human-curated, and
shipped as static plugin assets. The kid loop never calls a generation API.**

- **Style bible governs generation.** A locked reference look — sticker-flat/cel:
  flat tonal regions, confident outline, minimal shading — plus proportion rules,
  an anchor-point spec for gear fit, and the prompt scaffold that produces it.
  Authored in its own session (M4.5/1); every asset batch is generated against it
  and curated by a person before shipping.
- **Bodies are neutral grayscale; the kid's hue is applied at runtime.** The
  duotone pipeline maps grayscale tonal bands to the owner's identity
  tint/base/ink triplet — one asset serves all eight hues and both themes. This
  is what selects the flat-tonal style: texture-heavy looks (watercolor,
  clay-render) don't survive the mapping.
- **Layered compositing, not full portraits.** Bodies (3 species × 3 stages ×
  2 moods) and gear layers (worn: head/face/neck · props: beside/beneath) are
  separate assets composed at render time against the anchor spec — combinatorics
  stay linear.
- **Assets ship with the plugin** (`plugins/companion/public/…`), served flat like
  every plugin asset — not Postgres. ADR 042's bytes-in-Postgres pattern is for
  user uploads; a code-shipped library backs up with the repo, not the database.
- **Content drops are deploys.** New gear batches (seasonal items, scenes) run the
  same generate → curate → commit pipeline.
- **Designed-for extension, not v1: parent-gated custom gear.** A tier-4 surface
  where a parent prompts an item ("a hat for soccer season"), the server
  generates candidates inside the style guardrails, and the parent approves one
  into the milestone pool. Rare, human-gated, online-only, degrades gracefully.

## Why

- Runtime generation puts latency, moderation, a cloud dependency, and quality
  variance at the exact moment that must not disappoint a kid — and the Pi 3B
  cannot generate locally. Infinite content also deflates a collectible economy.
- Build-time generation dissolves the no-artist constraint that parametric SVG
  was working around, at zero runtime cost and with a human gate on everything
  a kid sees.
- Duotone-over-grayscale is the only approach where "the critter wears your hue"
  (ADR 061) survives raster art without ×8 asset duplication.

## Alternatives considered

- **Parametric SVG only** — buildable, provably (the direction artifact), but
  caps charm well below what generation offers.
- **Runtime generation in the kid loop** — see Why.
- **Canonical species colors** (no duotone) — frees the art, but fire-orange
  brushes terracotta/error-red at UI distance, blues collide with member hues,
  and same-species siblings look alike.

## Do not revisit unless

The duotone spike (M4.5/1) fails to produce charming results at 84–168px in both
themes — the fallback is canonical species colors with identity carried on
chrome, which weakens ADR 061's hue story but changes no other decision.
